insights.one_liner: CityHub is an Amsterdam-born urban lifestyle hotel brand mixing tech, community and design; its internship needs no Dutch, but it is not a visa sponsor.

culture.text: CityHub runs tech-driven, community-focused hotels with sustainable design for a new generation of travellers.
